rules: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling momentum on the entire wrapper.
Use GSAP ScrollTrigger for pinned sections (like the Philosophy section) and horizontal scroll (Identity Reel).
Split Hero: Left side text staggered entrance, right side image parallax reveal.
Identity Reel: Horizontal draggable scroll pinned over vertical scroll.
Philosophy Section: Pinned background, text highlights progressively as user scrolls.
Proof Strip: Left column sticky, right column normal scroll.
Marquee: Auto-scrolling ticker for voice testimonials using GSAP or react-fast-marquee.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a pure static single-page landing page in React (no backend).
Install `@studio-freight/react-lenis` for smooth scrolling and wrap the main app.
Use Google Fonts: Outfit (Display/Headings), Manrope (Body), Amiri (Arabic Accents).
Use native HTML/Tailwind for custom layouts (like the Bento Grid and Horizontal Scroll) rather than restrictive Shadcn components.
For the Islamic geometric pattern, use a subtle repeating radial gradient or an inline SVG data URI as a background image with ~5% opacity.
Implement the Horizontal Scroll using GSAP ScrollTrigger pinned container.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="nav-link-about").
Rely exclusively on the provided media URLs, do not use generic placeholder image services.
Use English primarily, adding Arabic phrases (in Amiri font) only as decorative accents (e.g., 'القدوة' for Al-Qudwah) with absolute positioning or soft overlays.
